billing_promo_once_idx.name: billing_promo_once_idx
billing_promo_once_idx.where:
"billing_invoices"."promo_code" is not null and "billing_invoices"."user_id" is not null
            and "billing_invoices"."status" not in ('failed', 'refunded')

items_draft_or_classified.name: items_draft_or_classified
items_draft_or_classified.value: ("items"."is_draft" = true) or ("items"."type" is not null and "items"."priority" is not null and "items"."topic" is not null)

items_recurrence_has_source.name: items_recurrence_has_source
items_recurrence_has_source.value: ("items"."recurrence_rule" is null and "items"."recurrence_text" is null) or "items"."recurrence_source" is not null
